line: I’m that nigga to the world, made Forbes, XXL
vault_lines: I'm that nigga to the world, made Forbes, XXL
meaning:
G Herbo has had a lengthy career in the rap game spanning almost a decade, with his first album being titled Welcome to Fazoland, released in 2014.

During his career, Herbo has been on both XXL back in 2016 and Forbes in 2021; for XXL, he was on a cypher with Dave East and he was on Forbes' “30 Under 30” list.

line: I was playin’ with cap guns, goin’ on drills on big wheels
vault_lines: I was playin' with cap guns, goin' on drills on big wheels
meaning: In this bar, Herbo reflects on his younger days running around in his hood. Through his wordplay, Herbo is clearly telling the listeners that he’s been active in streets since a young age, as cap guns and big wheels are very common toys for young children.

line: I’m treatin’ these bitches just like my cars, I pull out fast, I fill ’em with gas
vault_lines: I'm treatin' thesе bitches just like my cars, I pull out fast, I fill 'em with gas (Skrrt)
meaning: In this bar, Herbo makes comparisons between his women and his cars by “treating them the same.” He first compares how fast he can pull out in his cars to how fast he “pulls out” of women, and then compares filling his cars with gasoline to filling his women with “gas” (strong marijuana).

line: They say all rappers do is lie, I know my kind, I’m one of a kind
vault_lines: They say all rappers do is lie, I know my kind, I'm one of a kind
meaning:
In recent years, there has been an increasing amount of people who do not hail from the traditional “streets” background starting rap careers. Because of this, the whole concept of “rap cap” was formed; as the name implies, it describes rappers who lie within their lyrics OR who haven’t participated in activities they rap about.

In this bar, Herbo is saying that he’s “one of a kind” as he is one of the few rappers whose lyrics are real stories and situations.
